name: Washer Dryer Combo
definition: A household front-load cabinet that performs automatic washing and tumble drying in the same drum, with wash-only, dry-only or continuous wash-to-dry operation defined by the exact model.
includedScope: Ventless condenser and heat-pump all-in-one laundry appliances
excludedScope: Separate stacked washer and dryer pairs
Commercial laundry systems and standalone washers or dryers
primaryApplications: Unattended wash-to-dry cycles within the declared load limit
Wash-only or dry-only programs approved by the manufacturer
headline: Washer-dryer combo capacity, drying systems and buyer checks
description: This profile separates washing capacity from drying capacity, continuous-cycle load, drying architecture, utilities, lint and condenser care, installation and service parts so buyers can compare exact all-in-one models without treating one cabinet as one universal specification.
metaDescription: Washer-dryer combo guide covering separate wash and dry capacities, heat-pump and condenser systems, models, standards and component checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not electrical, plumbing, textile-care, refrigerant-service or installation advice. Confirm the exact regional model, manual, wash and dry load limits, supply, drain, ventilation, detergent, lint-filter and service-part numbers before procurement or use.

keyFacts.label: Capacity boundary
keyFacts.value: Washing, drying and continuous wash-to-dry loads are separate source-declared limits
keyFacts.evidence: IEC and official regional records distinguish washing-only and combined-cycle test loads, while EU product information can publish different rated wash and dry capacities.
keyFacts.scope: Exact model, program and regional rating method.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match utilities, dry-system type, lint and condenser care, drainage and service parts to the exact model
keyFacts.evidence: Official pages and manuals show materially different heat-pump, condenser, voltage, filter and installation arrangements.
keyFacts.scope: Exact regional model and installation site.

systemFlow.name: Water and washing
systemFlow.componentFamily: Inlet valves, dosing path, heater where fitted, drum, drive, suspension and drain pump
systemFlow.role: Wets, washes, rinses and spin-extracts the textile load before drying.
systemFlow.evidence: Official model sources document front-load washing functions, dosing and spin programs.
systemFlow.scope: Exact model, textile load and wash program.

systemFlow.name: Air and drying
systemFlow.componentFamily: Fan, duct, lint filter, heater or heat-pump circuit, heat exchangers and moisture sensing
systemFlow.role: Circulates conditioned air through the same drum and removes textile moisture.
systemFlow.evidence: LG and GE identify heat-pump systems while other official records define model-specific combined drying.
systemFlow.scope: Drying architecture and approved load of the exact model.

systemFlow.name: Condensate and control
systemFlow.componentFamily: Condensate path, pump or drain, controller, temperature and moisture sensors, door lock and seals
systemFlow.role: Controls the sequence, contains the load and routes wash water and drying condensate.
systemFlow.evidence: Official manuals specify drainage, door-lock, filter and cycle requirements by model.
systemFlow.scope: Exact installation, firmware and serial family.

variants.name: Heat-pump all-in-one
variants.taskScale: Full-size or compact household wash-to-dry loads
variants.operatorRelationship: User loads once and may select a continuous sequence
variants.spaceConstraints: Ventless placement still requires declared clearance, supply and drainage
variants.limitations: Heat-pump labeling does not establish cycle time, capacity or refrigerant-service equivalence.
variants.evidence: LG and GE publish named ventless heat-pump combo models.

variants.name: Condenser washer-dryer
variants.operatorRelationship: User selects wash, dry or combined operation within separate load limits
variants.spaceConstraints: Cabinet, door, plumbing, electrical and room-air requirements remain model-specific
variants.limitations: A ventless cabinet can still use water or a model-specific condensate path during drying.
variants.evidence: Whirlpool, AEG and Bosch publish combined washer-dryer configurations and installation data.

performanceMetrics.name: Wash and dry rated capacity
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Maximum source-declared textile mass or volume for each function
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Wash-only, dry-only and continuous-cycle loads may differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Never assume the full washing load can be dried in the same uninterrupted cycle.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IEC 62512 defines combined-function testing and official EU records publish separate kg ratings.
performanceMetrics.scope: Exact program, load and rating method.

performanceMetrics.name: Combined cycle time
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Elapsed time for a declared wash-to-dry load and program
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Load mass, initial moisture, cycle, options and test conditions control the result
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: A headline time for a partial test load is not a full-capacity guarantee.
performanceMetrics.evidence: LG qualifies its two-hour claim with a 10 lb DOE standard load; GE qualifies its approximately 90-minute claim with a 10 lb Quick Wash and Dry load.
performanceMetrics.scope: Named claim and stated conditions only.

performanceMetrics.name: Water and energy use
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Utility demand for wash-only or combined operation under a named method
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Jurisdiction, program, load and drying architecture differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not compare a wash-only label value with a complete wash-and-dry value.
performanceMetrics.evidence: IEC standards separate washing and combined performance; regional product records publish method-specific values.
performanceMetrics.scope: Named test method and exact model.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Test the actual continuous load, textile mix and dryness target before selecting capacity.
applicationFit.assessment: Test the actual continuous load, textile mix and dryness target before selecting capacity.
applicationFit.basis: Drying capacity and cycle duration can constrain a load that fits the washer.
applicationFit.limitations: Catalogue capacity and fastest-cycle claims do not predict every load.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Record load mass, program, total time, final moisture, lint care and energy under a witnessed trial.
applicationFit.evidence: Official claims expose different test loads and separate function limits.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Verify the complete utility and clearance drawing rather than relying on the word ventless.
applicationFit.assessment: Verify the complete utility and clearance drawing rather than relying on the word ventless.
applicationFit.basis: Voltage, water, drain, door swing, service access and room conditions remain model-specific.
applicationFit.limitations: No exhaust duct does not mean no installation constraints.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Attach the site survey and exact accessory, hose, outlet and drain requirements to the quote.
applicationFit.evidence: GE, Whirlpool and Bosch publish different electrical and dimensional requirements.

componentStack.name: Wash, dosing and drain system
componentStack.role: Processes wash liquid and mechanically cleans the load.
criticalChecks: Pump, hose and filter part numbers
componentStack.evidence: Official model documentation identifies different dosing and utility arrangements.
componentStack.scope: Exact market and serial family; no cross-model fit.

componentStack.name: Drum, drive and door system
componentStack.role: Contains and turns the same load during washing, extraction and drying.
variants: Door lock, glass and bellows assemblies
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturer pages and manuals define model-specific drum, drive and door systems.

componentStack.name: Drying and condensate system
componentStack.role: Conditions recirculated air and removes moisture after extraction.
criticalChecks: Refrigerant, fan, sensor and condensate part codes
componentStack.evidence: LG and GE disclose heat-pump systems; official manuals define exact filter and drainage care.
componentStack.scope: Exact model; refrigerant work by qualified service where required.

procurementDecisions.intendedTask: Complete washing and drying without load transfer
procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Continuous load, result, time and utilities
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by wash capacity or fastest headline cycle alone
procurementDecisions.assessment: Use matched witnessed loads and record the complete sequence.
procurementDecisions.basis: Drying limit, air system, load mix and program dominate the outcome.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No single catalogue value predicts every textile load.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Compare like-for-like continuous loads under documented settings.
procurementDecisions.evidence: IEC and official model sources expose different load and claim boundaries.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Supply, drainage, lint, condenser, pump, seal and electronics support
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming ventless format or family name establishes installation or part fit
procurementDecisions.assessment: Price the exact installed configuration and service parts.
procurementDecisions.basis: Regional assemblies, sealed systems and accessory codes differ.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Future part availability is not guaranteed.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain exact consumable and five-year service-part numbers in writing.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Manufacturers publish model-specific support and installation records.

engineeringChecks.check: Electrical, water, drainage and clearance installation
engineeringChecks.reason: A single cabinet combines high-speed washing, heat, airflow and condensate management.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Use the exact installation manual and qualified local installation where required.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official sources publish different supply and site requirements.
engineeringChecks.scope: Exact regional model and local rules.

engineeringChecks.reason: Shared drum and recirculating air paths create model-specific lint and cleaning duties.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Inspect the declared filters, seals and condenser-care procedure after representative cycles.
engineeringChecks.evidence: LG, GE and Samsung identify model-specific lint or condenser systems.
engineeringChecks.scope: Exact model; no hygiene outcome is inferred.

standards.name: IEC 62512:2012
standards.applicability: Methods for measuring combined washing and drying performance of household electric washer-dryers.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the standard scope and edition.
standards.scope: Confirm regional adoption and the exact declared method.

standards.name: IEC 60456:2024
standards.applicability: Methods for measuring washing-related functions of household washers and washer-dryers.
standards.evidence: IEC states that combined washer-dryer performance is assessed to IEC 62512.
standards.scope: Washing-related functions only; combined drying remains separately assessed.
